correct_contextual_reading.name: 吳曾
correct_contextual_reading.basis: Harvard identifies this author and book as Wu Zeng 吳曾 / Nenggaizhai manlu; MoE lists zēng and céng for 曾. The Zeng identification selects zēng rather than the generic library céng. Harvard romanization itself is untoned; the tone selection is an explicit dictionary-supported inference.

cases.finding: The actual Whisper whole sentence 無憎 is exactly homophonic with the context-correct Wu Zeng reading apart from orthography/punctuation. The comparator instead reads source 吳曾 as wu2 ceng2, creating a demonstrated text-comparison false negative.
cases.contrary_evidence: Primary 吳政 is wu2 zheng4, not an exact tone-and-initial match to wu2 zeng1. It is preserved and is not described as ASR agreement.
cases.case_recommendation: Keep 吳曾/source unchanged. Accept this residual textual flag as a likely false positive for the bounded episode decision; do not buy another take merely to satisfy the generic-name comparison.
cases.confidence_scope: Strong evidence of comparison/default-pronunciation mismatch; no direct acoustic certification.

cases.source_text: 能證明荔枝當天也到了嗎？
cases.primary: 能證明麗芝當天也到了嗎？
cases.secondary: 能證明立志當天也到了嗎?

correct_contextual_reading.basis: MoE 荔枝 explicitly gives lì zhī. MoE 麗 permits lì and lí, with lí listed for 高麗. Selecting the context-compatible lì of the actual primary string 麗芝 makes it homophonic with 荔枝.

cases.finding: The actual primary whole sentence 麗芝 has a context-compatible li4 zhi1 reading. The official library chooses li2 zhi1 for traditional 麗芝, while the otherwise same simplified 丽芝 yields li4 zhi1 and matchKind=sound. This demonstrates orthography/default-reading sensitivity in the comparator.
cases.contrary_evidence: Whisper 立志 is li4 zhi4 and is not strictly tone-identical to li4 zhi1. The secondary transcript cannot be called a confirming homophone. No listening was done to resolve the audible final tone.
cases.case_recommendation: Keep 荔枝/source unchanged. A bounded manual likely-false-positive disposition based on the actual primary homophone is reasonable; do not automatically rewrite or buy another take for this comparator result. Preserve the unresolved acoustic-tone limitation.
cases.confidence_scope: Demonstrated comparator/default-reading issue and plausible primary-ASR orthographic equivalence; actual final-tone correctness remains unverified by ear.
